verdict.rationale: Hatchet ships well-documented SDKs (Python/TS/Go/Ruby) and a CLI, and its docs are explicitly agent-legible via llms.txt/markdown mirrors, letting an AI-native user script or invoke it programmatically (hatchet-docs-10, hatchet-probe-3, hatchet-probe-rt-1, hatchet-probe-rt-2, hatchet-comm-15). However, probing for a public REST/OpenAPI specification found only 404s across standard paths, so there's no evidence of a documented, versioned public HTTP API beyond SDK wrappers. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST API spec, and independent confirmation that non-SDK HTTP clients can drive Hatchet directly.
